messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected on dedicated pool 'helios-prod-pool-7' (region-us-west). Pager sent to @kai and @sam. Auto-scaling attempted and failed to reduce tail latency.

kai: taking pager — hitting ~18% 5xx, median latency OK but p95 > 2.5s. Starting quick triage.

sam: on my way. any customer calls out impact?

maria: Heads up — customer Helios (enterprise, VPC) reported increased request failures ~5m ago via support. Contact on file: ops@helios.com, englead: rachel. I'm looping them in after we have a mitigation plan.

kai: initial look shows noisy tenant 'soteria-ai' driving long GPU queues on 3 nodes in pool-7. KV cache warmups + big batch jobs.

lin: that tenant's workload started a rollout ~10m ago? I see a large spike in sequence lengths and occasional OOMs in the runtime.

sam: can we throttle at routing layer and isolate the tenant? prefer soft isolation so other Helios threads keep running.

kai: agree. plan: 1) apply tenant-level throttle 2) move soteria to spare dedicated spare-pool-2 (live migration if possible) 3) if migration fails, evict noisy tenant and apply credits. Taking step 1 now.

kai: applying throttle policy (rate limit + smaller batch cap). Command: ```redwoodctl routing set-throttle --tenant soteria-ai --pool helios-prod-pool-7 --rps 20 --batch-max-tokens 256```

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: routing change applied by kai at 4820001290.

sam: I can kick off migration. Is spare-pool-2 warmed?

lin: spare-pool-2 has compatible kernels but needs KV-cache preload. I'll trigger preload job.

lin: preload job started: ```redwoodctl pool preload-kv --pool spare-pool-2 --model redwood-3b --tenants soteria-ai```

maria: pinging Helios ops to warn about possible session interruption and planned mitigation. templating short note now.

jen: please capture exact error classes and customer impact (percent requests affected, timeframe). I'll prep exec note if this becomes escalated.

sam: migration in progress. copying routing + sessions over. watching metrics.

incident-bot: NOTIFICATION: Migration job 4820001402 started by sam. Estimated time 2-4 minutes.

kai: seeing 5xx drop from 18% -> 6% after throttle. good signal.

sam: migration succeeded at 4820001420. soteria-ai now running in spare-pool-2. Rolling reconnects happening.

lin: KV cache hitrate stabilizing on spare pool. latency returning to baseline.

maria: Helios ops acknowledges mitigation, reported a small number of interrupted sessions but no data loss. Asking about credits for affected window.

jen: can SRE confirm affected window and rough RU/token counts for credit calc? we'll coordinate legal/finance after.

sam: affected window: 4820001234 - 4820001420 (≈3.1 minutes of elevated 5xx, plus reconnects for ~5 more minutes). Approx impacted tokens: ~1.2M tokens for Helios production tenant; affected requests ~0.8% of their monthly usage but 12% of one-hour traffic spike.

kai: mitigation is stable, putting pool under watch for 30m. leaving temporary throttle in place for 15m then slowly relax.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: Severity reduced to S2 at 4820001445.

maria: I'll draft a customer post-incident note and propose a goodwill credit for the reconnect period. How much do we want to propose? Typical range for this class is 2-5% of impacted window billing.

jen: start with 3% credit proposal for the affected minute-span and note the operational steps we took. Also propose a follow-up RCA timeline (48h) and an offer for a 1:1 exec briefing if they want it.

sam: for RCA I'm capturing logs, kernel selection traces, batch sizes, and runtime OOM traces. suspect regression introduced by tenant rollout mixing very long sequences and large batching config.

lin: I'll include recommendation to add a preflight for rollout that simulates seq length distribution across tenants and auto-enforce batch caps per-tenant.

maria: draft sent to jen + sam for review. I'm also collecting customer quotes about business impact.

jen: reviewing now. we should include: timeline, cause hypothesis, immediate mitigation, long-term actions, credit proposal, exec offer. Keep it concise.

sam: one more internal ask — did autoscaler fail to spin up nodes earlier? I'll follow infra path to ensure autoscaler had headroom.

kai: noted. I'm doing a handoff: sam now primary oncall for post-mitigation follow-ups. kai handing to sam.

sam: acknowledged. I'll own RCA and mitigation docs. Expect draft RCA in ~36h, exec-ready in 72h.

incident-bot: HANDOFF: oncall transferred from kai to sam at 4820001500.

maria: sharing draft with Helios ops, proposing 3% credit for the impacted billing window and offering an exec review next week.

Helios-ops (external): Thanks for the quick fix — we saw some failed requests but overall impact was limited. We'll take the exec offer. Please share RCA and credits estimate.

maria: noted, sending the credit estimate and scheduling slot for an exec briefing next Tue.

jen: post-incident action items: 1) Sam: RCA draft (36h) 2) Lin: rollout preflight + auto throttle per-tenant (2 weeks) 3) Kai: review autoscaler logs and ensure headroom behavior (48h) 4) Maria: customer comm + credits (ASAP).

sam: acknowledged. adding to tracker and will ping leads for timeline.

kai: thanks team. leaving watch duty but reachable if needed. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) at 4820001654. Post-incident follow-up thread created for RCA drafting.
